'''Boonan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Jaggalors on the Loose: Cruelty" />

==Biography==
During the renewed conflict, Boonan took part in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and was stationed at the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Axial Park]]. As the Imperials moved through the [[Axial Park]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] released several [[jaggalor]]s from the [[Coronet Zoo]] to prey upon the advancing Imperials. Despite the protests of zoo staff, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Boonan and his men hired an Imperial hero able to exterminate the rare [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] predators in order to end the threat they posed.<ref name="Jaggalors on the Loose: Cruelty" />
